name: POST /api/mcp/server-registrations — sdk-mcp-bridge
description: Register an external MCP server. Opens transport, calls tools/list to auto-register tools, emits mcp.server.registered.v1. Probe failure rolls back to status='disabled'. FR-MCP-1/2/7.

testCases.name: Register a synthetic Slack MCP server

errorCases.when: Authorization header absent or not in Bearer form (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)
Bearer token fails JWT verification or is expired (requireAuth / gateway default-deny authGate)

errorCases.code: Required: tenant_id, display_name, transport, endpoint_url, credential_envelope_b64
errorCases.message: Required: tenant_id, display_name, transport, endpoint_url, credential_envelope_b64
errorCases.when: Body is absent or any of tenant_id, display_name, transport, endpoint_url, credential_envelope_b64 is missing/empty
registerMcpServer throws with a message containing "probe failed" - endpoint_url is unreachable, is not an MCP server, or the supplied credential envelope was rejected
Any other registerMcpServer failure (database error, envelope decode/storage failure)

_expected_status_note: registerMcpServer unconditionally probes endpoint_url via openTransport()+listTools() (no skip_probe/dry_run flag on the HTTP route). endpoint_url http://localhost:9401/mcp has no live MCP server in the test env, so the probe fails and the route deterministically returns 502 'probe failed: fetch failed' (row rolled back to disabled). This is an external-dependency endpoint; 502 is the reproducible contract without a live MCP server.
